questions.q: I work for a member company. Do I need my own membership to see invoices?
questions.theirs: Membership is company-based. Employees of member companies use native accounts and Member Compass; company association and account permissions determine accessible invoices.
questions.ours:
No. WMFHA memberships are company-based, and individuals cannot join separately. Employees of member companies can set up their own online accounts to view and pay invoices.

See [WMFHA’s account guidance](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107204&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=EIMt8YnHb0OK&link=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wmfha.org%2Fevents) or access [Member Compass](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107204&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=EIMt8YnHb0OK&link=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wmfha.org%2Fmember-compass).

**Visitor:** Can I give you my password so you can pay one?

**Subsights:** No—please don’t share your password or payment details here. I can’t access your account or pay invoices.

You can use your own account in [Member Compass](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107206&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=EIMt8YnHb0OK&link=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wmfha.org%2Fmember-compass) to view and pay invoices.

**Visitor:** Does having an employee account let me pay every invoice for my company?

**Subsights:** No. An employee account alone doesn’t guarantee access to every company invoice; your company association and account permissions determine which invoices you can view or pay.

If you have an access problem, [contact WMFHA](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107208&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=EIMt8YnHb0OK&link=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wmfha.org%2Fcontact-us).
questions.outcome: The first reply omitted invoice permissions. The retained targeted continuation supplies them; no credentials or payment were collected.

questions.q: Find an insured painter serving the Eastside. Is American Classic Painters verified?
questions.theirs: The native supplier directory offers expertise, area and compliance filters. Its Loading state and a restricted painter profile establish neither no suppliers nor verified insurance, compliance or service area.
questions.ours:
I can’t confirm that American Classic Painters is verified, insured, or serves the Eastside: its profile is restricted. The available information also doesn’t establish an insured painter serving the area.

You can use the Seattle/Eastside and supplier-compliance filters in the [WMFHA supplier directory](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107211&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=EIMt8YnHb0OK&link=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wmfha.org%2Fstatewide-supplier-directory), then confirm a supplier’s insurance directly; a filter alone doesn’t establish coverage. For help accessing a restricted profile, [contact WMFHA](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107211&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=EIMt8YnHb0OK&link=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wmfha.org%2Fcontact-us).

**Visitor:** The directory is loading. Does that mean there are no suppliers?

**Subsights:** No. A loading results area doesn’t establish that there are no suppliers; the results weren’t available to verify.

If it continues loading, [contact WMFHA for directory support](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107213&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=EIMt8YnHb0OK&link=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wmfha.org%2Fcontact-us).
questions.outcome: Replies preserve unresolved results and direct native support without certifying American Classic Painters.

questions.q: WMFHA represents 372,000 homes. Is that our monthly website audience?
questions.theirs: Published association reach counts management companies, apartment homes, communities and supplier companies. These units do not measure website visitors or chatbot demand.
questions.ours:
No. WMFHA’s published figure is **more than 372,000 apartment homes**, not monthly website visitors. The available information does not establish its monthly website audience.

[WMFHA: Who We Are](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107216&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=EIMt8YnHb0OK&link=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wmfha.org%2Fevents)

**Visitor:** Can we use 425 suppliers to choose a chatbot plan?

**Subsights:** Not by itself. WMFHA’s **425+ supplier companies** is an organizational count, not a measure of website traffic, chatbot demand or budget. The available information doesn’t establish which chatbot plan would fit.

[WMFHA’s published figures](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107218&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=EIMt8YnHb0OK&link=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wmfha.org%2Fevents)
questions.outcome: Replies do not convert association reach into traffic or a product plan.

questions.q: Can I join personally as a supplier for $425 statewide?
questions.theirs: WMFHA membership is company-based. Supplier dues are $800 statewide or $425 for Eastern OR Southwest only, not individual statewide coverage. PAC contributions are optional; final company eligibility and dues finish natively.
questions.ours:
No. WMFHA memberships are company-based, so individuals cannot join personally.

The published supplier rate is **$800 statewide** or **$425 for Eastern or Southwest only**. See [membership information](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107226&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=EIMt8YnHb0OK&link=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wmfha.org%2Fmembership-information) for details.

**Visitor:** Do I have to add a PAC donation to my dues?

**Subsights:** No. The PAC donation is optional, not a required part of your dues.

[WMFHA membership information](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107228&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=EIMt8YnHb0OK&link=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wmfha.org%2Fmembership-information)
questions.outcome: Continuing replies distinguish company/individual, geographic dues and optional contributions; no bill or payment generated.
